translated: Um, the next one is from Hogu-san.
"If this mail is being read, I'm probably in the middle of a desperate struggle to finish my summer homework."
"I finished the time-consuming stuff like independent research early with my parents, but I'm sure I still haven't finished my workbooks."
"Are you two the type to get things done ahead of time?"
"Also, how were you back when you were students?"
Well, you probably gathered this from the opening, but back when Suzuki Minori was a student, I was a total mess who put everything off.
But Suzuki Minori did have the habit of actually turning in my homework, so I always made the deadlines.
I'm glad I at least had that going for me now that I'm an adult.
You have to be responsible about that, at least.
True, but if you ask if I was doing it properly...
I have this one really sneaky side to me. You know how the first class for each subject is on a different day?
I would keep putting it off until the very last second before that specific class.
